item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Modernize Arc-enabled Windows Servers with Azure File Sync
item.description:
Azure File Sync for Arc-enabled Windows Servers is now in preview. The update adds a guided Azure portal experience to help modernize servers and move or sync data with Azure Files while keeping the local file server model.

  • Source: Azure Updates
